components.name: Button
components.description: A button control that can be pressed to trigger an action.

props.name: text
props.description: The text displayed on the button

events.name: press
events.description: Fired when the button is pressed

notes: Prefer a single primary action per surface
Use Emphasized type for primary actions

components.name: Input
components.description: A single-line text input field for user data entry.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text displayed when the input is empty

notes: Always pair with a label for accessibility
Use appropriate input types for validation

components.name: Text
components.description: A text control for displaying read-only text content.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Maximum number of lines to display (0 for unlimited)

notes: Text content should be readable by screen readers

components.name: Title
components.description: A title control for displaying headings.

notes: Use appropriate heading levels for hierarchy
Proper heading levels are essential for screen reader navigation

components.name: Page
components.description: A page control that provides the main container for application content.

props.name: showNavButton
props.description: Whether to show the navigation back button

props.name: enableScrolling
props.description: Whether the page content is scrollable

events.name: navButtonPress
events.description: Fired when the navigation button is pressed

notes: Pages are the main container in mobile apps
Page title should be announced on navigation

examples.title: Simple Page
whenToUse: As main container in mobile apps

components.name: Table
components.description: A table control for displaying data in rows and columns.

props.name: growing
props.description: Whether the table has growing capability

events.name: itemPress
events.description: Fired when an item is pressed

components.name: Column
components.description: A column definition for table controls.

props.name: minScreenWidth
props.description: Minimum screen width for column visibility

props.name: demandPopin
props.description: Whether column pops in on small screens

components.name: ColumnListItem
components.description: A list item for table rows with multiple cells.

events.name: press
events.description: Fired when the item is pressed

notes: Row should be selectable if table is in selection mode

components.name: Select
components.description: A dropdown select control for choosing from a list of options.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The key of the selected item

notes: Use for single selection from predefined options

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: A date picker control for selecting dates.

notes: Date should be announced in accessible format

components.name: TextArea
components.description: A multi-line text input field for longer text entry.

props.name: growing
props.description: Whether the area grows with content

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: A toolbar for grouping actions and controls.

notes: Can be used in page headers and footers

components.name: SearchField
components.description: A search input field with search functionality.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Whether the search field is enabled

props.name: showSearchButton
props.description: Whether to show the search button

props.name: showRefreshButton
props.description: Whether to show the refresh button

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A modal dialog for displaying content and user interactions.

components.name: List
components.description: A list control for displaying items.

props.name: growing
props.description: Whether the list has growing capability

props.name: showNoData
props.description: Whether to show no data text

events.name: itemPress
events.description: Fired when an item is pressed

components.name: HBox
components.description: A horizontal box layout for arranging child controls horizontally.

notes: Layout should not interfere with accessibility

components.name: VBox
components.description: A vertical box layout for arranging child controls vertically.

notes: Layout should not interfere with accessibility

components.name: FlexBox
components.description: A flexible box layout for arranging child controls.

notes: Layout should not interfere with accessibility

components.name: Panel
components.description: A panel container for grouping related content.

components.name: Form
components.description: A form container for organizing form elements.

components.name: Label
components.description: A label control for labeling form fields and other controls.

props.name: labelFor
props.description: ID of the control this label is for

notes: Should be associated with a control
Label should be associated with its control

components.name: CheckBox
components.description: A checkbox control for binary selection.

examples.title: Checkbox
whenNotToUse: For single selection from options (use RadioButton)

components.name: RadioButton
components.description: A radio button control for single selection from a group.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the radio button is selected

props.name: enabled
props.description: Whether the radio button is enabled

notes: Use for single selection from options

components.name: Switch
components.description: A toggle switch control for binary on/off selection.

examples.title: Toggle Switch
whenNotToUse: For binary choice with label (use CheckBox)

components.name: ObjectHeader
components.description: An object header for displaying object information with title, subtitle, and attributes.
